cadre.compte.bienvenue: Welcome. You signed in with a temporary password. Choose your own password to access the tool.
cadre.compte.langue.aide: The translated content includes KPI names, definitions, themes, units, and list answers. Text without a translation shows in the installation language. You can also change the language in the top bar.
cadre.compte.langue.champ: Show menus, buttons, and translated content in
cadre.compte.mdp.aide: At least 8 characters, not a common password, not only digits.
cadre.compte.mdp.oublie: Forgotten your password? Ask an administrator to reset it. You then receive a temporary password.
cadre.compte.raccourcis.aide: Install a library template, compose from existing KPIs, or import a file.
cadre.connexion.aide: No account, forgotten password, or locked account? Contact {contact} to get a temporary password.
cadre.connexion.bloquee: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in 15 minutes.
cadre.connexion.trop_essais: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in 15 minutes, or contact {contact}.
cadre.erreur.400.texte: The tool could not read this request. If you entered the address yourself, check it. If not, ask your IT team to authorise the address of the tool (DOMAIN variable).
cadre.erreur.403.texte: This page is reserved for another role, or the form has expired. Go back, reload the page, then try again.
cadre.erreur.403.contact: If you need this page, contact the administrator of the tool.
cadre.erreur.csrf.texte: This page stayed open too long, or you signed in again somewhere else. Nothing was saved. Go back to the page, which reloads it, then try again.
cadre.erreur.404.texte: This page does not exist or no longer exists. The link is possibly out of date.
cadre.erreur.500.texte: An unexpected problem occurred. The tool recorded it in the server log. Try again in a moment. If the problem continues, tell the administrator of the tool.
cadre.erreur.503.stockage.texte: The server cannot save anything (the disk is full or write-protected). The tool did not save your last action, not even in part. Tell the administrator of the tool. When there is free space again, try again.
cadre.erreur.503.stockage.titre: Saving is not possible for now
cadre.compte.donnees.texte: See which personal data the tool keeps about you, for how long and who can see it.
cadre.donnees.chapeau: This page lists the personal data that {outil} keeps about the people who use it: why, for how long and who can see it. It is written from the settings of this installation, so it stays true when a setting changes.
cadre.donnees.gardees.aide: The tool keeps no other personal data. It sends no data to other services.
cadre.donnees.compte.contenu: Your name, e-mail address, role, team, language and the date of your last sign-in. For a reader or an auditor, also the organisations they can see.
cadre.donnees.compte.pourquoi: To sign you in, to show you what concerns you, to assign KPIs to you and to send you reminders.
cadre.donnees.compte.duree: As long as the account exists. An account that was never used can be deleted. After a first use (sign-in, assignment, value or change), it is deactivated instead, so that the history stays complete.
cadre.donnees.compte.qui: Administrators (Administration › Accounts). Your name and role are also shown next to the KPIs assigned to you, to the people who see these KPIs.
cadre.donnees.mot_de_passe.contenu: Only a scrambled form of your password, which cannot be turned back into the password.
cadre.donnees.mot_de_passe.pourquoi: To check your password when you sign in.
cadre.donnees.mot_de_passe.duree: Until you change it, or until an administrator gives you a temporary password.
cadre.donnees.valeurs.contenu: For each value: who entered it and who validated it, and when. Also your comments, your justifications of alerts and your override requests.
cadre.donnees.valeurs.pourquoi: To know who is responsible for each value and to follow the data entry.
cadre.donnees.valeurs.duree: As long as the value exists.
cadre.donnees.valeurs.qui: The people who can open the value in Data entry: its contributors, the validators of its organisation, administrators and auditors (in their organisations).
cadre.donnees.historique.contenu: Each change: who made it, when, and the value before and after. This includes the changes to accounts and settings.
cadre.donnees.historique.pourquoi: To keep a record that nobody can change, for audits.
cadre.donnees.historique.duree: With no time limit: the tool never deletes it. If an account is deleted, its changes stay, without the name.
cadre.donnees.historique.qui: Administrators (Administration › History). Auditors (History), only for the values of their organisations when the administrator chose organisations for them.
cadre.donnees.preuves.contenu: The file (PDF, JPG or PNG), its name, its size, who added it and when. A file can contain personal data: check it before you add it.
cadre.donnees.preuves.pourquoi: To support a value during the validation and the audit.
cadre.donnees.preuves.duree: As long as the value it supports exists, or until someone removes it.
cadre.donnees.preuves.qui: The same people as the value.
cadre.donnees.relances.contenu: Who received a reminder, who sent it, when, and how many values were still to fill in.
cadre.donnees.relances.pourquoi: To follow the data entry and to avoid sending the same reminder twice.
cadre.donnees.relances.duree: As long as the account of the person who received it exists.
cadre.donnees.relances.qui: Administrators. Validators see the reminders that they sent.
cadre.donnees.connexion.contenu: After {essais} failed attempts with the same identifier from the same network address, sign-in is blocked for {minutes} minutes. The tool counts the failures with a scrambled form of the identifier and of the address. A lockout adds one line to the server log, with the identifier typed and the network address.
cadre.donnees.connexion.pourquoi: To protect the accounts against people who try to guess a password.
cadre.donnees.connexion.duree: The count: {minutes} minutes after the last failure, and it is lost when the server restarts. The line of the server log: as long as your IT team keeps the server logs.
cadre.donnees.connexion.qui: Nobody in the tool. Your IT team can read the server log.
cadre.donnees.sessions.contenu: A cookie keeps you signed in. The server keeps your session, with your choices: language, campaign and organisation shown.
cadre.donnees.sessions.pourquoi: To keep you signed in from one page to the next and to remember your choices.
cadre.donnees.sessions.duree: Until you sign out. Without activity, the session ends after {heures} hours at most. Each night, the tool erases the sessions that have ended.
cadre.donnees.sessions.qui: Nobody: the tool does not show the sessions.
cadre.donnees.sauvegardes.contenu: A copy of the whole database and of the evidence files, so of all the data above. The tool also records each restore: when, which backup and who did it.
cadre.donnees.sauvegardes.pourquoi: To recover the data after a problem.

cadre.donnees.sauvegardes.duree_6h.one: The tool makes a backup every 6 hours and keeps the {nombre} most recent ones: about {n} day. It deletes the older ones. Your IT team can keep an external copy, with its own rules.
cadre.donnees.sauvegardes.duree_6h.other: The tool makes a backup every 6 hours and keeps the {nombre} most recent ones: about {n} days. It deletes the older ones. Your IT team can keep an external copy, with its own rules.

cadre.donnees.sauvegardes.duree_12h.one: The tool makes a backup every 12 hours and keeps the {nombre} most recent ones: about {n} day. It deletes the older ones. Your IT team can keep an external copy, with its own rules.
cadre.donnees.sauvegardes.duree_12h.other: The tool makes a backup every 12 hours and keeps the {nombre} most recent ones: about {n} days. It deletes the older ones. Your IT team can keep an external copy, with its own rules.

cadre.donnees.sauvegardes.duree_jour.one: The tool makes a backup every day and keeps the {nombre} most recent ones: about {n} day. It deletes the older ones. Your IT team can keep an external copy, with its own rules.
cadre.donnees.sauvegardes.duree_jour.other: The tool makes a backup every day and keeps the {nombre} most recent ones: about {n} days. It deletes the older ones. Your IT team can keep an external copy, with its own rules.

cadre.donnees.sauvegardes.duree_semaine.one: The tool makes a backup every week and keeps the {nombre} most recent ones: about {n} day. It deletes the older ones. Your IT team can keep an external copy, with its own rules.
cadre.donnees.sauvegardes.duree_semaine.other: The tool makes a backup every week and keeps the {nombre} most recent ones: about {n} days. It deletes the older ones. Your IT team can keep an external copy, with its own rules.

cadre.donnees.sauvegardes.duree_manuelle.one: Automatic backups are off. The tool keeps the most recent backup (made by hand or before an update) and deletes the older ones. Your IT team can keep an external copy, with its own rules.
cadre.donnees.sauvegardes.duree_manuelle.other: Automatic backups are off. The tool keeps the {n} most recent backups (made by hand or before an update) and deletes the older ones. Your IT team can keep an external copy, with its own rules.

cadre.donnees.sauvegardes.qui: Administrators (Administration › Settings › Hosting) and your IT team.
cadre.donnees.controle.contenu: Each night, the tool checks the consistency of the database. A result can give the identifier of an account as an example of a problem.
cadre.donnees.controle.pourquoi: To find a problem in the data quickly.
cadre.donnees.controle.duree: The {nombre} most recent results. The tool deletes the older ones.
cadre.donnees.controle.qui: Administrators (Administration › Settings › Hosting) and your IT team.
cadre.donnees.droits.contact: To see your data, to correct it or to ask for its deletion, contact {contact}.
cadre.donnees.droits.correction: An administrator can correct your name, e-mail address and team. An account that was already used is deactivated rather than deleted, so that the history stays complete.
cadre.donnees.droits.mon_compte: Change your language or your password in My account
cadre.donnees.droits.espaces: Your name, e-mail address and password are shared by the spaces that you can open. Each space keeps its own role, assignments and history.
cadre.donnees.entreprise.vide: Only administrators see this: add the statement of your company (data controller, data protection officer) in Settings › Identity.
cadre.donnees.pied: Written from the settings of this installation (version {version}).
cadre.reponse.titre: I am answering: {referentiel} · {periode} ({statut}). Click to change.
choix.kpi.agregation_temps.aucune: None: entered separately at each frequency
choix.referentiel.comparaison.n_1: Same period of the previous year
commun.erreur.serveur: The server is not responding: check the connection, then try again. Nothing has been saved.
cadre.compte.apparence.aide: Automatic follows the light or dark setting of this device. Your choice applies to this browser only. Printed pages and exported images stay light.

cadre.supprimes.aide.one: You can restore these items for {n} day after their deletion. After that, the tool erases them for good.
cadre.supprimes.aide.other: You can restore these items for {n} days after their deletion. After that, the tool erases them for good.

cadre.supprimes.vide.one: Nothing deleted recently. A saved export, KPI list or view that you delete stays here for {n} day, so that you can restore it.
cadre.supprimes.vide.other: Nothing deleted recently. A saved export, KPI list or view that you delete stays here for {n} days, so that you can restore it.

cadre.supprimes.vide_vues.one: Nothing deleted recently. When you delete one of your views, you can restore it here for {n} day.
cadre.supprimes.vide_vues.other: Nothing deleted recently. When you delete one of your views, you can restore it here for {n} days.

cadre.supprimes.par_inconnu: Deleted by an account that no longer exists
cadre.donnees.corbeille.contenu: A saved export, KPI list or Visualisation view that you delete goes to a trash, with the name of the person who deleted it and the date.
cadre.donnees.corbeille.pourquoi: To undo a deletion made by mistake.

cadre.donnees.corbeille.duree.one: {n} day after the deletion. Then the tool erases the item for good.
cadre.donnees.corbeille.duree.other: {n} days after the deletion. Then the tool erases the item for good.

cadre.donnees.corbeille.qui: The person who deleted the item (My account › Recently deleted) and the administrators.
cadre.compte.mdp.trop_essais: Too many attempts with the current password. Your password is not changed. Try again in 15 minutes.
cadre.compte.mdp.erreur_confirmation: The two new passwords are different.
cadre.donnees.bref.nombre: {n} types of data, all described below
cadre.donnees.bref.partage: No data sent to other services
cadre.donnees.bref.droits: See, correct, or delete your data: contact the administrator

cadre.donnees.preuves.duree_sensibles.one: For sensitive KPIs, the tool offers to delete the file {n} month after the end of the period; an administrator decides.
cadre.donnees.preuves.duree_sensibles.other: For sensitive KPIs, the tool offers to delete the file {n} months after the end of the period; an administrator decides.

cadre.aide.langues_guides: The guides are not available in your language yet. The English guide is shown.
cadre.compte.connexions.aide: In this space only. If you do not recognise a sign-in, change your password and tell an administrator.
cadre.compte.connexions.vide: No sign-in kept yet in this space.
cadre.donnees.historique_connexions.cont: For each sign-in: the date, the account, and the result (successful, failed, blocked after too many attempts). Never the password nor the network address. For a username that matches no account in this space, only a scrambled reference, never the text typed.
cadre.donnees.historique_connexions.pour: To see who used the tool and to find attempts to guess a password.

cadre.donnees.historique_connexions.dure.one: {n} day (setting in Administration › Settings › Hosting), then the tool erases the line during the night. Backups made in that time keep it until they are replaced.
cadre.donnees.historique_connexions.dure.other: {n} days (setting in Administration › Settings › Hosting), then the tool erases the line during the night. Backups made in that time keep it until they are replaced.

cadre.donnees.historique_connexions.qui: The administrators of the space, and its auditors in read-only. Each person sees their own last sign-ins in My account.
cadre.visite.relancer_aide: A few short hints on where to act.
cadre.visite.contributeur.1.texte: Data entry opens on everything assigned to you. Use “To fill in” or “Draft” to keep the rows that need you.
cadre.visite.contributeur.2.texte: Click the row of a KPI, or press Enter on it. The entry panel opens with the value, the previous period, and the comment.
cadre.visite.contributeur.3.texte: In the entry panel, choose a file under Evidence, or drag it in. Use a PDF, JPG, or PNG.
cadre.visite.contributeur.4.texte: Click “Validate and next”. Validating confirms that your entry is complete. It does not mean that the figure is audited.
cadre.visite.validateur.1.texte: Data entry lists the organisations you validate. Choose one to see what is left.
cadre.visite.validateur.2.texte: Open a draft row, read the value, the comment, and the evidence, then click “Validate”. Put it back to draft if something is missing.
cadre.visite.validateur.3.texte: Consistency lists the alerts of your scope. Open one to read the finding and the explanation of the contributor.
cadre.visite.validateur.4.texte: The Dashboard shows the completion rate of your scope. Send a reminder from there when a value is late.
cadre.visite.admin.1.texte: Administration opens on what is to be handled, the most urgent first. Each row has its own link.
cadre.visite.admin.2.texte: The Dashboard shows the completion rate of each organisation. Send reminders from there.
cadre.visite.admin.3.texte: Import values from a file, export your data, or get the audit file.
cadre.visite.admin.4.texte: The Help icon opens the guide of your role. You can show this tour again from there.
cadre.visite.lecteur.1.texte: The Dashboard says if the campaign is on track and shows the rate of each organisation.
cadre.visite.lecteur.2.texte: Visualisation shows views and charts. Open a view to explore the figures.
cadre.visite.lecteur.3.texte: The Help icon opens the guide of your role. You can show this tour again from there.
cadre.visite.auditeur.1.texte: Data entry shows every value with its evidence and its history. You can read, never change.
cadre.visite.auditeur.2.texte: Consistency lists the alerts with the explanations of the contributors.
cadre.visite.auditeur.3.texte: History lists every change and who made it. You can also read who signed in.
cadre.visite.auditeur.4.texte: Import / Export has the audit file: values, evidence, history, and alerts in one workbook.
